name: Media Bulk Download (Lite)
author: Mohamad Shukry

sections.description:
Media Bulk Download (Lite) lets you pick multiple files in the Media Library and download them as a single ZIP.

  • Works in Grid and List views
  • Adds a “Download as ZIP” bulk action (List) and a toolbar button (Grid)
  • Nonce + capability checks and path validation for security
  • Lite limits (to keep it fair):
    • Up to 10 files per ZIP
    • 2-minute cooldown between zips
    • 5 ZIPs/day per user

Want to remove limits and enable large libraries and advanced options? Get Pro →

How it works

  1. Go to Media → Library
  2. Select files (Grid or List)
  3. Click Download as ZIP
  4. A single ZIP is prepared and downloaded

Why this plugin?

  • One action to gather files for clients, archives, or backups
  • Zero setup, no external services
  • Secure by design (nonces, capability checks, sanitized paths)

Note: The Lite version enforces limits (10 files per ZIP, 2-minute cooldown, 5 zips/day). Upgrade to Pro for unlimited usage.
sections.installation:
1. Install from Plugins → Add New, search for “Media Bulk Download (Lite)”
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Media → Library
  4. Select your files and click Download as ZIP
sections.faq:
Where is the download button?

  • Grid view: a “Download as ZIP” button appears in the upper toolbar once you select items.
  • List view: use the Bulk actions dropdown → Download as ZIP.

What are the Lite limits?

  • Max 10 files per ZIP
  • 2 minutes between ZIP generations
  • 5 ZIPs/day per user
    These are enforced to keep the Lite plugin fair and stable. The Pro version removes limits.

Does it respect user capabilities?

Yes. Only users with upload_files capability can generate ZIPs.

Does it change or move media files?

No. Files are read and streamed into a ZIP; nothing is altered in your library.

Where can I donate or support development?

Thanks! You can donate here: https://pluginnests.com/donate/
